size_pct_nav: Approximately $0.959B October tranche = 0.327% of $293.4B June 2021 equity portfolio; approximate because Buffett gave 85% and ~$77. Full 14.658M-share cost ~$1.129B, not <=$1B. December $975M is market value, not cost.

drivers.driver: BUY by an unnamed deputy, not Buffett and not merger arbitrage. Berkshire owned 14,658,121 shares by year-end. At approximately $77 average cost, full cost was about $1.129B; October's approximately 85% was about $959M, meeting the requested <=$1B opening-control scope.

Buffett's signed February 17, 2022 clarification: one of two independent investment managers bought about 85% in October, completed in November, average cost about $77; no prior knowledge of Microsoft's January proposal. Exact deputy not named.
Buffett explicitly said the investment manager operated independently of him and Berkshire had no prior knowledge of Microsoft's proposal; the October purchase is not merger arbitrage.
